info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Tracks-v3-spec
info.description: The Track Retail Orders API enables users to fetch real-time tracking information for retail orders. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for e-commerce platforms, allowing businesses to monitor shipping statuses and delivery progress. Typical consumers include customer service teams and order management systems that require up-to-date tracking data to enhance customer experiences. By accessing this API, businesses can gain insights into their logistics operations and improve transparency for their customers.

get.summary: Track the status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to track the current status of their orders. It provides updated information on shipping, delivery, and any relevant changes to the order status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate tracking of an order. It allows clients to provide necessary details to retrieve the current status of the specified order. Ensure that all required fields are appropriately filled in for successful processing.

ListRetailOrdersTracksRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for tracking orders in the GET operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the order being tracked.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the tracking request.

state.description: Current state of the order being tracked.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the tracking request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message regarding the tracking operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit trail for the order tracking.
